mapper.select: SELECT * FROM board_members WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_members (board_id, member_id, board_role) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{boardRole})
mapper.update: UPDATE board_members SET board_role = #{boardRole} WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board_members WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT bm.member_id, m.username, bm.board_role FROM board_members bm JOIN members m ON bm.member_id = m.id WHERE bm.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY bm.board_role, m.username
SELECT bm.member_id, m.username, bm.board_role FROM board_members bm JOIN members m ON bm.member_id = m.id WHERE bm.board_id = #{boardId} AND bm.board_role = 'USER' ORDER BY m.username

SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.username, bm.board_role FROM members m LEFT JOIN board_members bm ON bm.member_id = m.id AND bm.board_id = #{boardId} WHERE m.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') ORDER BY m.username LIMIT 10

SELECT b.id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, b.color AS boardColor FROM board_members bm JOIN boards b ON bm.board_id = b.id WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND bm.board_role = 'INVITED' ORDER BY b.name
